markets.rules_secondary: The FDV must be the value shown in the "FDV" field on the coin's main CoinGecko page, not calculated from other metrics. markets.early_close_condition: This market closes at the first 10:00 AM ET following a qualifying above-threshold minute, or at the stated deadline if earlier.
markets.rules_primary: If a qualifying one-minute average of the CF Ethereum Real-Time Index (ETHUSD_RTI) is above $3,000 after issuance at Nov 9, 2026 at 2:00 PM EST and before Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00 AM EST, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The source is CF Benchmarks. Each minute after issuance and before the deadline is evaluated separately: discard the highest 20% and lowest 20% of ETHUSD_RTI observations in that minute and average the remaining 60%. The qualifying average must be strictly greater than the threshold; equality does not qualify. An earlier qualifying minute counts even if Ethereum subsequently falls below the threshold. Last trading is the earlier of the first 10:00 AM ET following a qualifying occurrence or the stated deadline. Expiration follows the effective ETHMINMAX amendment: the sooner of the first 10:00 AM ET following a qualifying occurrence, the stated deadline, the first 10:00 AM ET after the deadline that data is available, or one month after the selected date. If no data is available at expiration, the market resolves to No. Revisions after expiration are disregarded.

An announcement that the Miguel Díaz-Canel will leave the office within the next year is also encompassed by the Payout Criterion. If Miguel Díaz-Canel leaves solely because they have died, the associated market will resolve and the Exchange will determine the payouts to the holders of long and short positions based upon the last traded price (prior to the death). If a last traded price is not available or is not logically consistent, or if the Exchange determines at its sole discretion that the last traded prices prior to death do not represent a fair settlement value, the Outcome Review Committee will be responsible for making a binding determination of fair allocation.

Clarification (05/23/26): To clarify, Miguel Díaz-Canel currently holds two positions relevant to this market: First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba and President of Cuba. For purposes of this contract, departure from either position will satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Bitcoin crosses the specified price threshold.
markets.rules_primary: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is below $55000.00 starting Feb 5, 2026 and before Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00am ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

markets.early_close_condition: This market closes at the first 10:00 AM ET following a qualifying above-threshold minute, or at the stated deadline if earlier.
markets.rules_primary: If a qualifying one-minute average of the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) is above $120,000 after issuance at Nov 10, 2026 at 12:00 PM EST and before Jan 1, 2027 at 12:00 AM EST, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The source is CF Benchmarks. Each eligible minute after issuance and before the deadline is evaluated separately: discard the highest 20% and lowest 20% of BRTI observations in that minute and average the remaining 60%. The qualifying average must be strictly greater than the threshold; equality does not qualify. A qualifying minute counts even if Bitcoin subsequently falls below the threshold. Price movements before issuance do not count. This is not a single-trade spot-price touch or the price only at the deadline.

Last trading is the earlier of the first 10:00 AM ET following a qualifying occurrence or the stated deadline. Under the effective BTCMINMAX filing, expiration is the sooner of the first 10:00 AM ET following a qualifying occurrence, the stated deadline, the first 10:00 AM ET after the deadline that data is available, or one month after the selected date. If no data is available on the Expiration Date at the Expiration Time, the market resolves to No. Revisions after expiration are disregarded. The full filed contract terms govern contingencies.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the price criterion is met.
markets.rules_primary: If the price of ZEC after issuance and through 11:59 PM ET on Dec 31, 2026 is ever below $450.00, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF ZECUSD_RTI price for ZEC. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. If the trimmed mean associated with any single minute during the period is below the threshold, the market resolves to Yes. This methodology reduces the impact of extreme price spikes or drops. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the price criterion is met.
markets.rules_primary: If the price of SOL after issuance and through 11:59 PM ET on Dec 31, 2026 is ever below $70.00, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF SOLUSD_RTI price for SOL. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. If the trimmed mean associated with any single minute during the period is below the threshold, the market resolves to Yes. This methodology reduces the impact of extreme price spikes or drops. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.
markets.title: Will SOL trimmed mean be below $70.00 by 11:59 PM ET on Dec 31, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market may close early if the outcome is determined, in accordance with the contract and Rule 7.2.
markets.rules_primary: If Bitcoin’s mining difficulty, expressed in trillions and rounded to two decimal places, is strictly above 150.00 T at any point in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The observation window is January 1 through December 31 of the specified year, inclusive, in Eastern Time. The difficulty in effect at the start of the year and each difficulty adjustment taking effect within that year count. Difficulty is calculated from the target encoded in the block header’s bits field, using the maximum target encoded as 0x1d00ffff, and rounded to two decimal places in trillions before comparison. A block counts only when it is on the valid Bitcoin chain with the most cumulative proof-of-work and has at least six confirmations. Adjustment timing uses its block-header timestamp. Sources, in order: the Bitcoin blockchain, mempool.space, Blockstream Explorer, and Blockchain.com. Any displayed hashrate equivalent is an approximation assuming 600-second blocks (difficulty × 2^32 / 600); it is informational and is not a settlement input. Corrections, chain/protocol contingencies, no-data treatment and early expiration follow the contract.

markets.rules_secondary: At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF BNBUSD_RTI price for BNB. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Bitcoin crosses the specified price threshold.
markets.rules_primary: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $99999.99 starting 01/02/2026 06:00 PM and before Dec 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if either price threshold is reached.
markets.rules_primary: If BTC reaches $50,000 before reaching $100,000 between Issuance and 11:59 PM on Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market tracks whether the cryptocurrency price reaches the first threshold before the second threshold. "Reaches" means the price touches or falls below $50,000 (the lower threshold) OR touches or rises above $100,000 (the upper threshold). The first threshold reached determines the outcome. Price is measured using the CF Real-Time Index, taking a simple average over any 60-second period. If $50,000 is reached first, the market resolves to Yes. If $100,000 is reached first, the market resolves to No. If neither threshold is reached by the deadline, the market resolves to No. If no data is available at expiration, the market resolves to No.

markets.rules_primary: If Lucas Ocampos leads Liga MX in goals for the 2026 Apertura regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Lucas Ocampos must have the highest total goals across the entire regular season as documented by the official league statistics. If  Lucas Ocampos competes for multiple teams within the league during the season, statistics from all teams are combined. If Lucas Ocampos does not play any games due to injury, suspension, retirement, or other reasons resolve to No.
If multiple players finish tied for the most goals and the league does not officially declare a single leader through a tiebreaker, the market will resolve as a dead heat. "Yes" Contracts on each tied player will pay an equal share of $1. For example, if two players tie, each "Yes" Contract pays $0.50. If three players tie, each "Yes" Contract pays approximately $0.33. No contracts pay $1 minus the Yes payout.
If the league officially uses a tiebreaker to determine a single leader, the market resolves based on the league's official winner.

markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on the highest number of overtimes in a single game during the 2026 college football regular season. An overtime period is any period of play after regulation ends. From the 3rd overtime onward, the alternating two-point conversion series counts as an overtime period. An overtime period counts as played once it commences, via a legal snap (in the first two overtimes) or a first two-point attempt (in the third overtime and onward). Overtime periods that are scheduled but never start do not count. Once started, an overtime period counts in full, regardless of its duration or whether both teams get a possession or attempt.

All regular season games count towards this market. Conference championship games, Bowl games, and College Football Playoff games are not included in the regular season.
